principles: Keep CLI semver as a runtime/capability marker, not a repository-wide artifact counter.
Record provenance as append-only evidence metadata with deterministic digest and idempotent write behavior.
Keep workflow commands host-neutral and read-only for inspection surfaces.
Only fix the real correctness gap: non-runtime DONE artifacts lack provenance, not all version skips are bugs.
drivers: DONE post-merge already has exact changed paths and before/after main commits.
Existing version-bump policy intentionally excludes experiments and general docs.
Users need a durable queryable record for delivered non-runtime artifacts after DONE.

options.name: separate-artifact-release-ledger
pros: Preserves semver boundary while giving users queryable provenance.
Works for experiments/docs/declared non-runtime artifacts without package-version churn.
Can be smoke-tested through pure digest and append-idempotency logic.
cons: Adds a new ledger and two inspection commands.

options.name: broaden-cli-version-bump-predicate
pros: Uses existing version bump output and no new ledger.
cons: Turns semver into noisy repository-wide churn.
Contradicts existing experiment/docs exclusions and B-11ad scope.
Would not record artifact path/digest provenance.

options.name: manual-summary-only
cons: Future non-runtime DONE stories remain ambiguous unless humans remember to explain the skip.

rationale: Choose a separate artifact release ledger because it directly records provenance for non-runtime DONE deliverables while leaving CLI/runtime semver rules intact.

preMortem.scenario: Ledger records .lattice lifecycle metadata as released artifacts.
preMortem.trigger: DONE merge changed only story metadata files.
preMortem.consequence: Users see fake product artifact releases and the ledger becomes noisy.
preMortem.mitigation: Classifier excludes .lattice/**, runtime inputs, package lock/version files, and empty releasable path sets.

preMortem.scenario: DONE writes duplicate release rows on retry.
preMortem.trigger: Partial DONE recovery or repeated helper call sees same story/commit/digest.
preMortem.consequence: artifact_release_list shows multiple identical releases and audit trails become confusing.
preMortem.mitigation: Use a stable idempotency key from storyId, commit, and artifactSetDigest; append only when no existing row matches.

preMortem.scenario: Artifact release is confused with CLI version activation.
preMortem.trigger: Output/docs use version-like language without boundary text.
preMortem.consequence: Users expect package semver to change or runtime behavior to activate.
preMortem.mitigation: Render and document the row as provenance only; keep version-bump smoke proving experiments do not trigger CLI semver.
